authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source family/window. MHCLG Planning Data local-plan-boundary dataset contains 364 local plan boundaries and defines each boundary as the area a local plan covers; individual authoritative entities expose reference, organisation/local-authority binding and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. This materially changes authority/source family and spatial-binding method from ONS identifier/boundary registers to MHCLG local-plan legal geography. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference, LPA/LAD code or name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any of the 364 boundaries would therefore be guessing. No coverage_area_id can be bound to the slot, so no source-area record or parcel record is accepted and no Plan0 package is emitted.
